column1: # Lane social-post, wave 30. Partition src/components/social/post/** and
# src/components/social/profile/**.
# TWO FAMILIES, BOTH TAKEN TO THE BOTTOM, AND NEITHER PROMOTED. Every node
# below was opened first hand through the Plugin API on 2026-09-06 and no
# number here is carried from an earlier row. `get_metadata` was not used for
# any of it: it reports a text node's line BOX, and the single largest defect
# this pass found is a component built against the box (14) instead of the
# face (12).
# TWO FIXES LANDED, each with its oracle in the same commit and each value
# proved red by a mutation applied ALONE from a pristine copy and restored by
# copying that copy back - never by a reverse string replace, because several
# of these tokens also appear in the comment explaining them:
#   1939a90bd  the comments panel, its composer and its rows (15 cases,
#              17 mutations, all RED)
#   e5472d9f9  the trade sheet's colours and boxes (16 cases, 20 mutations,
#              all RED)
# 124 checks pass across src/components/social/post at 15:55 on 2026-09-06,
# tsc clean. A green is a moment, not a state.
# THE FINDING THAT DECIDES EVERY POST/TOKEN ROW BELOW, AND IT IS NOT A PARITY
# ONE. `src/components/social/post/**` IS NOT MOUNTED. Grepped over `src/` on
# 2026-09-06: the only importers of TokenPostDetail, TradePanelSheet,
# PostDetailTabs, PostCommentList, PostCommentComposer, PostTokenChartCard and
# TokenStatStrip are the partition's own barrel `post/index.ts` and its own
# tests. `src/App.tsx` declares no `/post/...` path; `/token/:symbol` is a
# REDIRECT to `/crypto/:symbol` (App.tsx:1854). So these seven files draw the
# frames correctly and draw them on NO SCREEN. Every post row here therefore
# stays `not-started`, which is the catalogue's own rule for a component
# nothing renders, and the reason column now says what is actually left: a
# route and a container, not a build. A parity suite cannot see this - it
# renders the component itself, so it is green either way.
# THE MEASUREMENT THAT DROVE THE FIRST FIX. A line box is not a face, and the
# comment row is 12px at every board with only the leading stepping:
#   row height         50               56               56
#   name               Manrope Bold     12/16            12/16
#                      12/14 #FFFFFF
#   stamp              Mulish 12/14     12/14            12/16
#   body / Reply       Manrope 12/14    12/16            12/16
# The height is the SUM and not a fourth reading: 14+4+14+4+14 = 50 and
# 16+4+16+4+16 = 56. The shipped rows were 11px on a flat 14 at every board.
# THE INSTRUMENT NOTE. Three values here are a flat #FFFFFF fill under a NODE
# opacity, and either number alone is the wrong answer: the comment stamp and
# `Reply` at 0.64, the composer's paperclip at 0.44, and `Amount` in the trade
# sheet at 0.64. `--muted-foreground` (#B3B9CC) is none of them, and it is what
# all three shipped as.

column5: OFF partial AND ONTO THE HONEST VALUE. WHAT IS DRAWN MATCHES, re-measured this pass on `11474:216312` rather than cited: `Frame 304` 319x270 radius 12 padding 16 gap 16 on #001615; the heading accent a 3x18 RECTANGLE at radius 6 filled #17F9B4 at paint opacity 0.24, held 8 off its text; the rule a VECTOR stroked #122524 at weight 2; the two tiles STACKED (`Frame 279` VERTICAL, gap 8) at 287x90, radius 8, padding 12, label-to-figure 16, on #122524. The code resolves 18/8/12/16 here and its md and lg rungs carry the 19/8/16/12 and 24/16/16/12 the other two boards draw. WHAT IS NOT DRAWN CANNOT BE, and that is why this is not partial: the frame's area chart, its 1D/1W/1M/1Y/ALL pills and its `+0.94%` delta all need a market-cap SERIES. Probed live 2026-09-06 - `public` holds exactly two market-cap columns, `social_tokens.market_cap` (current, SELECT `true`, 4 rows) and `social_token_transactions.market_cap_after`, whose ONLY SELECT policy is `rls_user_select` for `authenticated` with `user_id = auth.uid()`, on a table holding 0 rows. A visitor can never read another creator's series - not today at 0 rows and not later at a million. Backfilling would not fix it; only a new readable source would. The card renders the current cap over an explicit unavailable state rather than five dead controls or a flat-at-zero chart.
